notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass
notes.notes:
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url][/i] is finally available on Steam!
After months of work, the second episode of the Scary Shadow Spot series is ready to take you on a journey into psychological horror, filled with eerie puzzles and hidden truths.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Cursed Saloon and the Mystery of John Doe[/h2]
This time, you’ll be thrown into the heart of the Wild West, in a forgotten saloon lost in the desert. Here, time has stopped, and the ghosts of a dark past are waiting… for you.
Who is John Doe? What really happened at Bicchiere Amaro? Only by exploring the saloon and solving its puzzles will you uncover the truth.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]A Psychological Horror Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2]
Like the first episode, Bicchiere Amaro draws inspiration from the legendary series The Twilight Zone, delivering a story shrouded in mystery, with plot twists that will make you question everything you think you know.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]What to Expect[/h2]
✔️ A chilling and surreal atmosphere.
✔️ Puzzles that will test your logic.
✔️ A cast of… dead characters.
✔️ A story that will pull you in until the final revelation.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Add the Game to Your Wishlist![/h2]
If you enjoyed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096050/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Ultimo_Addio]Ultimo Addio[/url], you’ll love [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Bicchiere Amaro[/url] too. And if you haven’t played the first episode yet, now is the perfect time to catch up!

💀 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354980/Scary_Shadow_Spot__Bicchiere_Amaro/]Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro[/url] is available NOW on Steam!
📌 Add it to your library and let us know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell: The Release is Near!
notes.notes:
[i]Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farwell[/i] is now in its final stages! After months of hard work, I am thrilled to announce that the game is [b]almost ready[/b] for the official release.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Feedback from Beta Testers[/h2] I had the privilege of having the game tested by a group of selected beta testers, and their feedback has helped refine every detail. The eerie atmosphere and twists that define the game have been polished to offer you an unforgettable experience.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Inspired by The Twilight Zone[/h2] The game is inspired by the legendary TV series [i]The Twilight Zone[/i]. Every puzzle, every shadow, has been designed to make you doubt what is real and what lurks in the depths of the mind.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Questions? We Are Here to Answer![/h2] Do you have any curiosities or questions about [i]Scary Shadow Spot[/i]? We are here to answer anything that comes to mind. What secrets are hidden in Mark's house? What awaits you in the darkness? We can't wait to hear your questions!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Thank You for the Support![/h2] Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release day.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Doesn't Matter Games Studio[/b]

[previewyoutube=MUQzjq8dcP0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: BLOODY INK HAS ARRIVED
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
With great excitement and satisfaction, I can finally announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700240/Bloody_Ink/]Bloody Ink[/url] is available for purchase.
This new game has required a lot of commitment, dedication, and energy, but in the end, it has given me a lot of satisfaction.
I hope you enjoy it at least half as much as the joy it has given me in creating it.

May fear be with you!
Daniele

notes.title: FREE DEMO OF BLOODY INK
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700240/Bloody_Ink][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/4d94fb674569c0e3ce9728ccd9ce0614ad7fe9ce.png[/img][/url]

The development of Bloody Ink is progressing relentlessly. I can't wait to see you dive into this new horror adventure that unfolds within the narrative universe of Lost Alone.

While anticipating the mysteries related to Bloody Ink, a free demo is now available: "Bloody Ink - The Hour Of Fear." Enjoy this short story detached from the main game. Don't be afraid of spoilers for the main game: what you see in the demo won't be found in the full game! Except for some preview mechanics and certain game environments that will begin to introduce you to the world of Bloody Ink!

A microphone is not required to play, but... If you have one: be careful about what you say.

notes.title: DEMO: Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before
notes.notes:
[h1][b]LOST ALONE ULTIMATE[/b] is coming![/h1]

Get ready to dive back in as [b]George Tellaselv[/b].
Whether you are entering this adventure for the first time or have already played the Lost Alone trilogy: you are about to discover a [b]new[/b] world of terror.

Lost Alone Ultimate is not a remake of the [b]Lost Alone[/b] trilogy, but a [b]re-made[/b]!

To let you savor the new world that awaits you, the demo is now available: [b]Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before[/b].

You will experience the day leading up to the events of Lost Alone Ultimate, savoring a light appetizer of the terror that awaits you.

[b]Lost Alone Ultmate - The Day Before[/b] is a self-contained demo that offers content that [b]won't be present in the final game[/b].

So: Enjoy a little secret sneak peek into George's life.

notes.title: MARCH UPDATE
notes.notes:
Third update of the year.
Following your feedback, reviews and watching your gameplay, I have made important changes to Who Knocks.

Here are all the news you will find:

[list]
[*] It is no longer possible to open the menu during cutscenes. This will prevent malfunctions.
[*] Digital keys have been numbered. Now you can see from the inventory which locker will be opened.
[*] Improved boss fight.
[*] Fixed the problem related to spawn. When the final monster is killed, the spawn of enemies will also be interrupted.
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[*] Improved game stability.
[/list]

[b]WARNING: Running this update will corrupt your saves and you will have to start the game over.[/b]

notes.title: THE IMPROVEMENTS HAVE ARRIVED!
notes.notes:
Second update of the year.

[*] Extended candle life. Each candle will have 30 minutes of autonomy before being consumed.

[/list]

[b]WARNING: Running this update will corrupt your saves and you will have to start the game over.[/b]

notes.title: IMPORTANT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Happy New Year to all.
Following your feedback, your reviews and watching your gameplays, I have made major changes to Who Knocks.

Here are all the news you will find:

[list]
[*] The method of accessing the Trophy Chamber has been changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/a13b320367ac9aa5c5dfc69b60d0e09a4a7fa2d0.jpg[/img]
[*] Some keys have been made more visible, making them easier to find in-game.
[*] A small clue has been added to solve the puzzle of the movie figurines.
[*] In the second part of the game, all lockers and digital keys have been numbered to limit back tracking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/15f9712ce22a77da5f0cf751a177fc9dcdae702c.jpg[/img]
[*] In the game part, an Item Box has been added to facilitate inventory.
[*] It is now possible to skip cutscenes without having to open the menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/b0e34edba6406d4a9ecd80ac7a28871ba266c766.jpg[/img]
[*] 6 new paintings have been added to the Trophy Room.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the mouse cursor to disappear at the end of the game.
[*] After collecting the Purifier Key, monsters stop spawning.
[*] The boss fight has been made easier.
[*] Digital Keys have been made bright to make them easier to find.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/5f53f4c4f8fb87add3c760c2dfc701206e9a8670.jpg[/img]
[*] The puzzle pieces have been made bright to make them easier to find.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43243771/ebfbb284fe0793db152aa790897cf8feebfd2362.jpg[/img]
[*] Romina's corpse has been fixed so that you can reach objects behind her body without problems.
[/list]

[b]WARNING: Running this update will corrupt your saves and you will have to start the game over.[/b]
